pages.text: $(o)There was no paper left to write it on, so the Order carved it into stone and set a Warden on top.$(br2)The Warden could not read. It was never built to.$(br)We told it to keep watch over a door it had never seen open,$(br)and it obeyed until someone came to open it.

pages.title: The Sleeping Portal
pages.text: No roof, no name, and half built.

$(o)To the north, where the ground rises, there is something larger than the Observatory.$(br)It has no roof and no name yet.$(br)Those who raised it called it the Portal,$(br)and it is the only work of ours that was never finished.$(br2)$(o)If you are truly reading this, you already know where to begin.$(br)We will not remind you twice.$()
